description: Parameters of the algorithms/ package: HRV bands, DFA and sample-entropy settings, the minimum valid window of every HRV measure, and the ECG-derived breathing-rate estimator. Read by algorithms/core.py. Frozen on the date below, before any held-out data was read; validate_*.py refuses a held-out set while 'frozen' is null. No value here is changed in response to a held-out result.
tuned_on: HRV settings are textbook definitions and were not tuned. Minimum windows come from the literature and from the simulation in analysis/hrv_min_window_simulation.txt (docs/hrv_minimum_windows.md). Breathing parameters were tuned on the 23 BIDMC development subjects only (bidmc.dev; analysis/breathing_bidmc_dev_tuning.txt).

breathing.selection: Chosen on the BIDMC development subjects (analysis/breathing_bidmc_dev_tuning.txt). The band is fixed at 4-40 breaths/min by requirement, not by BIDMC: paced breathing at 6/min must lie inside it, although 6-40 scores better on this dataset. Among the 4-40 rows, the setting with the highest pooled coverage whose per-subject MAE has a 75th percentile of 1.0 breaths/min or less under the causal filter. agree_bpm, min_beats, min_beat_coverage, outlier_mad, share_halfwidth_cycles and lomb_oversample were set by hand and not tuned.

bidmc.split_rule: By SUBJECT, not by recording: the 53 recordings come from 46 MIMIC-II subjects (bidmc_csv/bidmc_NN_Fix.txt, 'MIMIC II matched wdb ID'); s03386 and s11342 have four recordings each and s25323 two. Subjects sorted by ID alternate dev, held-out, dev, ... and every recording follows its subject.
bidmc.split_fixed: 2026-11-11, from the Fix.txt metadata alone, before any BIDMC signal or annotation was read
bidmc.heldout_rule: evaluated once, after 'frozen' is set; no parameter is changed in response
bidmc.reference: per annotator, 60 / mean time between consecutive annotated breaths in the window; a window is kept when the two annotators agree within ref_agree_bpm, and their mean is the reference (Pimentel et al. 2017)

mitdb.heldout: the 36 records in data/mitdb_heldout; second use of that set, as a check of arithmetic against neurokit2 with everything here frozen
